	limit = { check_variable = { which = rb_le_chosen_job value = 98 } }
	if = { limit = { rb_le_job_trader = yes } event_target:rb_le_selected_leader = { change_background_job = trader } }
}

else_if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { which = rb_le_chosen_job value = 99 } }
	if = { limit = { rb_le_job_transference_volunteer = yes } event_target:rb_le_selected_leader = { change_background_job = transference_volunteer } }
}

else_if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { which = rb_le_chosen_job value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { rb_le_job_treasure_gatherer = yes } event_target:rb_le_selected_leader = { change_background_job = treasure_gatherer } }
}

else_if = {
	limit = { check_variable = { which = rb_le_chosen_job value = 101 } }
	if = { limit = { rb_le_job_wrangler = yes } event_target:rb_le_selected_leader = { change_background_job = wrangler } }
}
